objective: Improve the reliability, maintainability, repository discoverability, and AI operating efficiency of Project Factory through measured architecture discovery, bounded supporting engineering work, and evidence-backed target-state design without performing an unauthorized major architecture rewrite or canonical merge.
budget_scope: repository-architecture-v1 supporting routine engineering and measured validation
success_criteria: current repository architecture and lifecycle state are inventoried from repository evidence
target-state architecture and an incremental reversible migration sequence are documented before major code movement
AI usage is attributed by role and stage wherever authoritative telemetry exists, with unavailable metrics explicitly marked unavailable
resource hotspots including repeated reads, searches, retries, oversized context, and coordination overhead are identified
a matched Company OS versus direct-session benchmark design is frozen before benchmark outcomes are observed
the Repository Architecture Steward capability receives an evidence-backed organizational recommendation
zero new production regressions are introduced by bounded supporting engineering work
no major architecture rewrite, canonical merge, workforce activation, destructive cleanup, publishing, or deployment occurs under this contract
reporting_requirements: every management decision and who took it
total model cost against the authorized budget where authoritative monetary telemetry exists
AI resource usage broken down by role and stage wherever telemetry exists
all unavailable token or plan-usage measurements explicitly marked unavailable rather than estimated
identified resource waste and the recommended correction
Company OS versus direct-session benchmark results with quality and reliability outcomes
a recommendation on whether Company OS should be kept, simplified, or selectively routed
a recommendation on whether repository_architecture_steward should become a permanent capability
any exception that ended the objective early
notes: CEO authorizes architecture discovery, target-state design, efficiency measurement, and bounded supporting engineering. Major architecture redesign approval and canonical promotion remain separate CEO gates. No standing grant.
